heading.text: Updates: what is coming and what changed

data.text: Where the numbers come from. Build progress: the public list of build runs and their jobs, read by the browser every 3 minutes while a build is active. Change list: one public file rebuilt on every build from the commit history. Nothing about the home is sent.

rules.text: Rules for the build. A failed or replaced build is never shown as done. Estimates are labelled as estimates. No link opens an outside site; commit ids are text. Core can be installed after stage 5, without waiting for the operating system images.

lang.text: Languages. Change titles are English. The explanation under a change shows English, Cantonese, or both paragraphs one above the other, following the language mode. Both-languages mode makes each open change about twice as tall.

site.text: The updates log is its own public site with one page per version, built from the public change list. Each page: what the version is, highlights with a working demo per feature, every change by part of the product, how to update, older and newer versions.
